name: Logistics Insight Corp - GM EV Parts Warehouse - Detroit MI

fieldNotes.facility: Brand-new (~2023-2024) 793,520 sq ft single warehouse on the redeveloped former AMC headquarters site at 14250 Plymouth Rd; built by NorthPoint Development, GM-owned, operated by Logistics Insight Corp (LINC, a Universal Logistics Holdings company) supplying EV parts to GM Factory Zero. Confirmed via Crain's Detroit / GM Authority and current satellite imagery.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance off Plymouth Rd via a wide divided access drive that leads into the SW truck yard. Property is fully fenced/landscaped-bermed. No barrier arm or booth resolvable in current imagery at the road, but the truck yard is a secured private GM-owned operation; classified as a controlled gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth resolvable in satellite imagery at the entrance. Given a GM-owned EV-parts secured site, access is most likely kiosk / call-box / badge controlled rather than a staffed shack — remoteGs set true. Low confidence on the absence of a shack.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous loading-dock run the full length of the SW long face (trailers backed in at intervals) plus a secondary bank along the north end wall. NE long face along the railroad is solid windowless wall. Estimate ~100-120 doors total -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Long striped trailer-parking lot runs parallel to the SW dock apron with marked stalls and trailers parked without tractors -> dedicated drop yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically distinct dock clusters on different faces (SW long face and north end wall) -> ship/receive can run from separate banks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided access drive and a large open SW truck yard apron leave ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs immediately along the NE property edge but no spur enters the property; building is not rail-served.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~68 acres for the fenced industrial parcel (excludes the adjacent public park strip on the west side).
